items.title: fix: don't panic when a cancelled job runs composite post steps
items.body:
Post steps of a cancelled job run on a fresh context with no job error container, so SetJobError panics and kills the runner process along with every other job it is running.

items.title: fix(plugin): find requested files in CopyOut archives
items.body:
Single-file readers now find the requested entry in CopyOut archives, skipping directory headers and unrelated files. Adds regression tests and documents the accepted archive paths.
Fixes: #1680
